Simple harmonic motion (SHM) can be modeled mathematically as a second-order differential equation derived using Newton’s second law. The solution to this differential equation is the object’s position as a function of time, which is sinusoidal. The position function can be differentiated with respect to time to find the object’s velocity and acceleration functions, which are also sinusoidal.
